propositions: Duplicate literal policy frozensets and explicit intercept selection ladders in _cli._main_dispatch must be deleted, consolidating to registry-derived policy sets as the sole authority.
Every command intercept route must carry exactly one registered runtime-used argparse factory and lazy handler with init policy metadata, dispatching through a single execution path.

Whole-route and whole-parser shadow comparison must report no unapproved deltas in identity, mount, argv, output, exit codes, aliases, or capability posture after retired policy authorities are removed.
Both CLI generators (gen_cli_help.py and gen_cli_reference.py) must produce byte-identical outputs across consecutive runs with --check validation passing.
Source modules must remain under 800 lines with no new files under 100 lines, and all lint, type, and complexity gates must pass after removing compatibility scaffolding.
